title: Add IETF QMux dissector (draft-ietf-quic-qmux-01)
description:
Add a dissector for the IETF QMux protocol defined in
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-ietf-quic-qmux/, formally
adopted to the QUIC Workng Group. Qmux multiplexes QUIC-style
streams over TLS. It  reuses QUIC v1 frame formats but doesn't
use packets. Encryption is delegated to TLS.

QMux provides a substrate for application protocols to use. QMux
requires that appliction protocols are negotiated using ALPN.
This change bases protocol detection on values in ALPN.

To provide a working example, this change uses HTTP/3 over QMux,
which has an I-D but is not adopted by any IETF WG; see
https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kazuho-httpbis-http3-over-qmux/.
This protocl choice helps demonstrate that wireshark can be modified
to support an existing application protocol dissector over QUIC with
minimal changes.

Detection: ALPN-based via tls.alpn (h3qx-01 direct, h3qx-* prefix).

QMux-specific dissection:
- QMux Record framing (varint Size + QUIC frames)
- QX_TRANSPORT_PARAMETERS frame with individual TP parsing
- QX_PING request/response frames
- Prohibited frame and transport parameter detection with expert info
- TLS desegmentation for records spanning TLS record boundaries

QUIC frame reuse:
- All permitted QUIC frames are parsed by the existing QUIC dissector
  via dissect_quic_frame_type_for_qmux(), a thin wrapper that hides
  internal types. Frames display with quic.* filter names.
- STREAM reassembly and subdissector handoff handled by the shared
  QUIC code path.

Application protocol support:
- ALPN is mapped to its base protocol (h3qx-01 -> h3) and looked up
  in quic.proto / quic.proto.datagram tables. HTTP/3 works over QMux
  with zero changes to packet-http3.c, including DATAGRAM frames.
- Direction detection via pinfo->match_uint (TLS server port).

Follow QMux Stream:
- Per-connection numbering (qmux.connection.number) and per-stream
  tracking with follow tap. Works via tshark -z follow,qmux.

Changes to existing code:
- packet-quic.c: quic_info_data_create_for_qmux() creates a minimal
  quic_info_data_t; dissect_quic_frame_type_for_qmux() wraps the
  frame parser (+34 lines)
- packet-quic.h: declarations (+15 lines)
- packet-tls-utils.c: ALPN prefix match for h3qx- (+2 lines)
- CMakeLists.txt: add packet-qmux.c/h (+2 lines)

Test captures and 7 pytest tests covering transport parameters,
HTTP/3 decode, CONNECTION_CLOSE, DATAGRAMs, desegmentation, Follow
Stream, and expert info validation.

Test captures generated from a fork of quiche that has WIP QMux
support; see https://github.com/LPardue/quiche/tree/qmux-support/qmux-demo

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)

@@ -1201,3 +1201,91 @@ class TestDissectUsbHid:
                 '-Tfields', '-eusbhid.data.padding',
             ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
         assert stdout.strip() == '03,ff07\n01,b907\n00,0000'
+
+class TestDissectQmux:
+    def test_qmux_transport_parameters(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify QMux transport parameter dissection.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-Y', 'qmux.tp.parameter.type',
+                '-Tfields',
+                '-e', 'qmux.tp.max_idle_timeout',
+                '-e', 'qmux.tp.initial_max_data',
+                '-e', 'qmux.tp.max_record_size',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        # Both sides send transport params; check values are present
+        assert '30000' in stdout
+        assert '10000000' in stdout
+        assert '16382' in stdout
+
+    def test_qmux_http3_decode(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify HTTP/3 decodes over QMux.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-Y', 'http3',
+                '-Tfields', '-e', 'http3.headers.method', '-e', 'http3.headers.path',
+                '-e', 'http3.headers.status',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        assert 'GET' in stdout
+        assert '/index.html' in stdout
+        assert '404' in stdout
+
+    def test_qmux_connection_close(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify CONNECTION_CLOSE frame dissection.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-Y', 'quic.cc.reason_phrase',
+                '-Tfields', '-e', 'quic.cc.reason_phrase',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        assert 'done' in stdout
+
+    def test_qmux_datagram(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify DATAGRAM frame dissection over QMux.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux-dgram.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux-dgram.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-Y', 'quic.dg',
+                '-Tfields', '-e', 'frame.number',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        # Client sends 3 datagrams, server echoes 3 back
+        assert count_output(stdout, r'\d+') >= 2
+
+    def test_qmux_desegmentation(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify QMux records spanning TLS records are reassembled.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux-deseg.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux-deseg.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-Y', 'http3',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        # HTTP/3 should decode despite TLS record fragmentation
+        assert grep_output(stdout, 'HEADERS')
+
+    def test_qmux_follow_stream(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify Follow QMux Stream works.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-qz', 'follow,qmux,ascii,0,0',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        assert 'Follow: qmux,ascii' in stdout
+        assert 'GREASE is the word' in stdout
+
+    def test_qmux_prohibited_frame(self, cmd_tshark, dirs, capture_file, test_env):
+        '''Verify no warnings or errors in normal QMux traffic.'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'qmux.keys')
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-r', capture_file('qmux.pcap'),
+                '-o', 'tls.keylog_file: {}'.format(key_file),
+                '-zexpert,warn',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=test_env)
+        assert not grep_output(stdout, 'Warns')
+        assert not grep_output(stdout, 'Errors')
